Apr 12-20, 2026 have very intense 💥 energy signature as multiple planets  come together in #Aries ♈️ for several tight back-to-back conjunctions, intensifying around the Apr 17 New Moon 🌙. In particular, Mars will conjunct Neptune & Saturn in short succession. When Mars opposed these two last August, triggering similar degrees, there were multiple major incidents with themes of naval accidents, water pollution, hazmat fires, and large #earthquakes with tsunami.

📅 August 2025 Major Global Incidents:

🌊 Kamchatka Earthquake & Tsunami (July 29–Aug 6): A massive magnitude 8.8 earthquake—the 6th strongest ever recorded—struck offshore the Kamchatka Peninsula. It triggered Pacific-wide tsunami warnings, with waves reaching 1.7 meters in Hawaii and 1.2 meters in California during the first week of August.
🔥 The Gifford Fire (Aug 6–10): This became California’s largest wildfire of the year. By August 6, it had scorched over 131 square miles across Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties, threatening over 870 structures and severely degrading air quality across the Southwest.
☢️ Neches River & PA Hazmat Leaks (Aug 6–8): Following a barge collision, a significant benzene discharge occurred in the Neches River, Texas. Simultaneously, a major gas line leak in Coatesville, Pennsylvania, forced the evacuation of residential apartment buildings.
🏔️ Tracy Arm Landslide-Generated Tsunami (Aug 10): A "mega-landslide" of approximately 100 million cubic meters of rock and ice collapsed into this Alaskan fjord. This triggered a localized tsunami with waves reaching at least 30 meters (100 feet) at Sawyer Island, causing extreme shoreline scouring.
🚢 China-Philippines Naval Collision (Aug 11): A high-speed crash occurred between a Chinese navy destroyer (Guilin) and a coast guard cutter (3104) while they were attempting to block a Philippine patrol vessel near Scarborough Shoal, resulting in severe damage to both Chinese ships.
